scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: What do you call true death? Do you know?

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Some people say, when you give up on yourself, that is true death.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Some people say, when you no longer have a heartbeat or breath, that is true death.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: But I think a saying is very true: When all the people in the world forget about you, that is the true death.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: So I started a company. I want to let this brand spirit remain in this world.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: I started teaching my sales formula. I want to let the sales formula improve everyone's lives and remain in this world.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: I started writing down my thoughts and ideas on the internet every day, just to leave a little bit of myself in this world.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: We work so hard today, isn't it just to leave a mark on the earth and let people remember us?

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Death is not scary, do you know? The most scary thing is that we worked hard to live for 80 years, but didn't leave a single trace of value to prove we lived.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Finally, I give this sentence to everyone. Let's think about whether death is scary or not.
